items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: In those days, Arthur Campbell was very famous around here then. You heard of him, didn't you, Arthur Campbell? ... He was good too, Arthur Campbell. He had a strange way, a beautiful way of playing, I thought, Arthur Campbell.

ctx.x: Oh, he played all of them. At one time he was down there. Played at Piron sometime. Then Mario Perez sometime. I used to play, you see, had so many different bands downtown in that day. All different men had bands. And that day, all you had to do was play and get you a bunch of men together. Played at Jimmy Pileout sometime. He played everybody sometime. But Frank, he played in bands that Frank Kahino was in a lot of times. But he could play everything, anything. He didn't read, but he played everything they…
Yeah, I think he made a couple of records on the band.
